verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Snowflake serves an llms.txt file at docs.snowflake.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with structured agent-oriented content describing the platform, directly satisfying the story. This is corroborated by extensive agent-oriented documentation (Cortex MCP server, CLI docs) that an agent pointed at these docs could consume. missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation that agents actually use llms.txt successfully in practice.
